blocks.text: ANTIPOLO — Dawn Macandili-Catindig has shown that her impact on her new team, Choco Mucho, goes beyond her steady floor defense, also providing leadership that led to the Flying Titans’ early 2-0 lead in the PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series. With fiery duo of Sisi Rondina-Rosales and Eya Laure leading the offense, Catindig has taken charge on defense to help Choco Mucho stay perfect with a sweep of ZUS Coffee, 25-20, 25-17, 25-20, on Thursday at Ynares Center Antipolo. “I’m really happy because I’m starting to build a connection with the team, and I hope we can continue to develop that […]...
